messages.subject: Caspian v Harburn — CMC outcome and next steps
messages.plaintextBody:
Henry, Sofia,

The CMC went well. The Court made the order broadly as we proposed: Extended Disclosure by 17 July, witness statements by 11 September, a single quantum expert each, and a 5-day trial from 18 January 2027. Importantly, the judge directed the parties to consider mediation by 19 June — Harburn has indicated July.

The sealed order will follow. Disclosure of Harburn's internal cost-reduction documents is now our priority; I'm confident it will support our case that the termination was budget-driven.

Sarah
